param.name: reference
param.label: Reference CDS
param.help: In-frame coding sequence (FASTA) of the target gene. Only the first record is used unless stated otherwise.

macros.token:
This tool is part of the **disassembler** suite, which reconstructs in-frame coding haplotypes of a target gene from planetary-scale sequence indexes: `Logan <https://github.com/IndexThePlanet/Logan>`_ unitigs found through a kmindex search, or Logan contigs found through a LexicMap search. Both routes end in a reference-guided codon alignment and a phylogeny.
The kmindex route runs **harvest** (merge the kmindex query shards), **stratify** (optional: cut a size-capped cohort), **walker** (reconstruct one haplotype per accession), **sieve** (optional: thin near-duplicates), then **msa**. The LexicMap route runs **lexicmap**, optionally **sieve**, and (for parity with the kmindex route) optionally **msa**.
